notes.title: 1.004 Minor Updates & Fixes
notes.content:
(This text was translated using machine translation, so there may be minor errors. Thank you for your understanding)

1. Thanks to ★猫👾🌙, some errors in the English text have been fixed. Additionally, minor errors in other languages have also been corrected.  

2. Added a new firing mode setting for the Chain Gun, allowing you to choose between "Hold" and "Toggle." (Default setting: Hold)  
Hold: Hold the button to fire, release to stop / Toggle: Each press toggles between firing and stopping.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44782861/ab342a595ece0e2415fe063a7c424d0ecd1c1128.jpg

3. Dialogue text will now be displayed in different colors depending on the character speaking. When set to OFF, the text will be displayed in the previous white color. (Default setting: ON)  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44782861/61c91559f7e7a1e7ddc5cb22c99b19067534d70a.jpg

4. If weapon firing is automatically stopped due to dialogue, pausing, or death, the weapon will now resume firing automatically when the game resumes, provided that the firing input (such as holding the fire button) is still active.

notes.title: 1.002 Update
notes.content:
1. The explosion effect of the Airblast Bomb (third weapon) has been reduced in size when it detonates at a very close distance to the player.

2. In windowed mode, the mouse will now be confined within the game window during battles, unless the game is paused.

3. Upon entering the canyon(Stage 8 scene), the player will be granted temporary invincibility due to the inability to move over long distances.

4. When the Boss of Stage 9 (SR-4000 THUNDER DRAGON) first appears, there will be a slight delay before it begins attacking.

5. In Endless Mode, a mechanism to detect enemies has been added. If no enemies appear due to a rare bug, new enemies will automatically spawn after a brief wait (the cause of this bug is unknown, so this feature may not work).

6. In Endless Mode, the MAX threat level has been adjusted from [500%/300%] to [1000%/400%].

7. The probability of high-altitude diving scene(Stage 7 scene) occurring in Endless Mode has been increased.

notes.title: Minor Changes on Scoring Mechanism
notes.content:
1. After the Boss appears, the score will not automatically increase until the Boss is defeated.
2. The score for defeating the Boss has been changed from 3000 points to 5000 points (the Final Boss score remains at 30,000 points with no changes).

notes.title: Small Fix on Final Boss
notes.content: Fixed an issue where some bullets of the final boss would fire backward when using bullet time.

notes.title: Small Fix On Skill's Text
notes.content: Fixed when the Chinese/Japanese UI is turned off (while you are using Chinese or Japanese), the skill name only shows AEGIS OF LUCIOLLA Lv.1 when using the chip in the Skills Menu.

notes.title: Small Fix
notes.content: Fixed the issue where the boss's life could not be displayed when Skip Story was enabled in stage 9

notes.title: Small Fix
notes.content: Fixed the issue where the laser would not disappear in some cases

notes.title: Demo Update Summary
notes.content:
It's been some time since the release of the demo, and I would like to thank you for your support of Mirage Feathers. During this period, several important functional updates have been made to the Mirage Feathers Demo, so let's summarize them here.

1. You can now customize most of the keys in the options menu, and the key icons in the tutorial will directly reflect your changes. By customizing the keys, you can play using devices other than the controller and keyboard, such as a flight stick or a Mega Drive 6-button controller.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44782861/5fb80bd04ffa0069728c9ecd0793b8c5108a7771.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44782861/405649d36fa934a4daa17a1854eadb8950a61d80.jpg


2. Now supports 16:10, 4:3, and 21:9 resolutions. Resolution options will be automatically obtained from the system. When selecting 16:10 or 4:3, the vertical field of view will be expanded; when selecting 21:9, the horizontal field of view will be expanded. Story CGs are locked to 16:9 display, with other areas filled in black.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44782861/bcddb00274fce71112e03ce262ecf94f4fe63b57.jpg


3. Sensitivity settings, smoke opacity settings, warnings for bullets from off-screen, low HP and energy warnings, and hit warnings have been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44782861/384184ecbccc298b5f4e326a56dd8a99ac29f7cb.jpg


4. The Japanese translation of the story mode has been fixed (and also fixed the full version).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44782861/fa5d19240e2d3fc55bf3ba156ab808de98d70967.jpg


Mirage Feathers Demo will continue to be available even after the Steam Next Fest, so if you haven't tried it yet, please give it a go!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719060/
